Hannah / Laura — attaching the subprocessor inventory snapshot and a first-pass VPC->Redwood diagram: v2 includes:

- Ingress path: encrypted transfer from FinTax client to regional ingress (EU); TLS 1.2+, mutual TLS option for dedicated instances.
- Edge routing: requests routed to nearest region; for FinTax we should propose EU-only routing + deny fallbacks to other regions.
- Serving runtime: where KV caches live (short-lived, encrypted at rest, TTL 6 hours by default for session tokens).
- Subprocessors: logging provider (LogStream Ltd.), metrics (Metricly Cloud), and hosted-cache provider (CacheCo). The CSV enumerates roles and whether they see PII.

Two specific control callouts for FinTax's questionnaire:
1) PII classification: we classify input text as Controlled (PII) when it contains name + tax identifier / SSN / financial account numbers; such inputs are only stored in ephemeral caches and excluded from long-term logs unless explicitly opted-in.
2) Access: Privileged access requires SSO + 2FA; service accounts have scoped keys and are rotated quarterly.

If Laura gives the go-ahead on the DPA copy, I can produce a single package (DPA + diagram + subprocessor CSV + short cover note).
